panels.title: Disabled users with licenses – ordered by last activity

targets.expr: (m365_user_last_activity_timestamp{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} or on(customer, tenant, upn) m365_mailbox_last_activity_timestamp{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"}) * 1000 and on(customer, tenant, upn) m365_user_info{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",enabled="false",licensed="true"}

panels.description: Last activity = last successful sign-in, or the mailbox report's last activity when sign-in data is unavailable (no AuditLog.Read.All / Entra ID P1).

targets.expr: m365_mailbox_last_activity_timestamp{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} * 1000 and on(customer, tenant, upn) (m365_mailbox_used_bytes{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} >= on(customer, tenant) group_left() (m365_threshold{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",check="mailbox_size_gb_min"} * 1073741824))

m365_mailbox_info{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} and on(customer, tenant, upn) (m365_mailbox_used_bytes{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} >= on(customer, tenant) group_left() (m365_threshold{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",check="mailbox_size_gb_min"} * 1073741824))

panels.title: Emails sent/received – last N days (above thresholds)

targets.expr: m365_mail_sent{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} and on(customer, tenant, upn, period) ((m365_mail_sent{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} > on(customer, tenant) group_left() m365_threshold{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",check="mail_sent_max"}) or on(customer, tenant, upn, period) (m365_mail_received{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} > on(customer, tenant) group_left() m365_threshold{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",check="mail_received_max"}))

m365_mail_received{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} and on(customer, tenant, upn, period) ((m365_mail_sent{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} > on(customer, tenant) group_left() m365_threshold{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",check="mail_sent_max"}) or on(customer, tenant, upn, period) (m365_mail_received{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} > on(customer, tenant) group_left() m365_threshold{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",check="mail_received_max"}))

panels.description: Users above mail_sent_max or mail_received_max over the report period (reports.period: D7, D30, D90 or D180).

panels.title: OneDrive activity by size (GB)

targets.expr: m365_onedrive_total_bytes{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} and on(customer, tenant, upn) (m365_onedrive_used_bytes{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} >= on(customer, tenant) group_left() (m365_threshold{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",check="onedrive_size_gb_min"} * 1073741824))

m365_onedrive_used_bytes{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} / (m365_onedrive_total_bytes{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} > 0) and on(customer, tenant, upn) (m365_onedrive_used_bytes{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} >= on(customer, tenant) group_left() (m365_threshold{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",check="onedrive_size_gb_min"} * 1073741824))

m365_onedrive_file_count{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} and on(customer, tenant, upn) (m365_onedrive_used_bytes{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} >= on(customer, tenant) group_left() (m365_threshold{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",check="onedrive_size_gb_min"} * 1073741824))

m365_onedrive_last_activity_timestamp{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} * 1000 and on(customer, tenant, upn) (m365_onedrive_used_bytes{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} >= on(customer, tenant) group_left() (m365_threshold{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",check="onedrive_size_gb_min"} * 1073741824))

m365_onedrive_info{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} and on(customer, tenant, upn) (m365_onedrive_used_bytes{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} >= on(customer, tenant) group_left() (m365_threshold{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",check="onedrive_size_gb_min"} * 1073741824))

panels.description: OneDrives at or above onedrive_size_gb_min. File count and last activity come from the usage report (onedrive.source: report, the default).

panels.title: Mailboxes inactive longer than inactive_days (mailbox report)

targets.expr: m365_mailbox_used_bytes{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} and on(customer, tenant, upn) (((time() - m365_mailbox_last_activity_timestamp{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"}) / 86400 > on(customer, tenant) group_left() m365_threshold{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",check="inactive_days"}) or on(customer, tenant, upn) (m365_mailbox_info{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} unless on(customer, tenant, upn) m365_mailbox_last_activity_timestamp{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"}))

m365_mailbox_info{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} and on(customer, tenant, upn) (((time() - m365_mailbox_last_activity_timestamp{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"}) / 86400 > on(customer, tenant) group_left() m365_threshold{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",check="inactive_days"}) or on(customer, tenant, upn) (m365_mailbox_info{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} unless on(customer, tenant, upn) m365_mailbox_last_activity_timestamp{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"}))

panels.description: Mailboxes whose report Last Activity Date is older than inactive_days (thresholds.yaml), or that have no activity at all ('never'). Works without sign-in data.

panels.title: M365 Available License Count
panels.description: Available = enabled (prepaid) minus consumed units, one card per tenant and SKU, fewest first; negative means over-assigned. Colours: red ≤ 0, orange 1–5, green > 5. Hidden: SKUs with exactly 0 available, and SKUs with no enabled units (free/viral). Total and consumed: the Licences table.

panels.title: Inactive licensed users (days since last sign-in)

targets.expr: ((time() - m365_user_last_signin_timestamp{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"}) / 86400) > on(customer, tenant) group_left() m365_threshold{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",check="inactive_days"} and on(customer, tenant, upn) m365_user_info{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",enabled="true",licensed="true"}

panels.title: Licensed users who never signed in (days since account creation)

targets.expr: (((time() - m365_user_created_timestamp{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"}) / 86400) and on(customer, tenant, upn) m365_user_info{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",enabled="true",licensed="true"} unless on(customer, tenant, upn) m365_user_last_signin_timestamp{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant"} and on(customer, tenant) (m365_tenant_feature{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",feature="signin_activity"} == 1)) * on(customer, tenant, upn) group_right() (label_replace(m365_user_license{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",sku_name=""}, "sku_name", "$1", "sku", "(.*)") or m365_user_license{customer=~"$customer",tenant=~"$tenant",sku_name!=""})
